summary_text: On 2026-03-08 (weekend), one Green Kiwi (Unbranded) was purchased in the afternoon. This timing aligns with the population baseline, where afternoon shares (0.2526) are lower than morning (0.3246) and evening (0.3027) shares. The product is a fresh fruit suitable for immediate consumption or use in meals. This is a single observation from one date. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for green kiwis, a specific brand (none was supplied), or a one-time purchase. No other orders are available to confirm repetition or routine.
